{{Quote|Guy's a moron. Doesn't know a vibroscalpel from a field cauterizer. He barely passed final exams. How is he top doctor in the Republic?|Archiban Kimble|<ref name="Opportunity Knocks" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' worked as a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The man attended<ref name="Opportunity Knocks" /> the [[First Republic Medical Academy of Coruscant]],<ref name="Holonet">{{Holonet|companions|doc|Doc}}</ref> the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant's]] medical program, alongside a [[xenopathology]] student named [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], and the man's medical skills and intelligence were notoriously poor. However, the individual was able to graduate from the [[University/Legends|University]] despite barely passing his final exams and remained on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], eventually developing a cure for a minor flesh-eating [[virus]] known as [[Zabrak Scalp Necrosis]]. The fame that the achievement brought him saw the doctor appointed as acting head of the [[Republic Health Administration]], something that Kimble believed was only possible because the man had bribed his way to the position.<ref name="Opportunity Knocks" />

==Behind the scenes==
The doctor was first mentioned in the conversation "Opportunity Knocks" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class' companion character Kimble, who goes by the name "Doc" in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The doctor's [[Species/Legends|species]] and name are never identified during the conversation.<ref name="Opportunity Knocks" />
